Bug_Title: SQL: Nonconstant string passed to execute or addBatch method on an SQL statement (SQL_NONCONSTANT_STRING_PASSED_TO_EXECUTE)
Bug_Details:
The method invokes the execute or addBatch method on an SQL statement with a String that seems
to be dynamically generated. Consider using
a prepared statement instead. It is more efficient and less vulnerable to
SQL injection attacks.
Bug_Explanation: The SQL query is being constructed by concatenating user input with a string. This can lead to SQL Injection if user input is not properly sanitized.
Trigger_Explanation: The showBug method is called in the test case. This calls the vulnerable part of the code where a non-constant string is directly concatenated with the SQL query which can lead to SQL injection.
